tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /oṃ dang āḥhūm̐ gi /bdud rtsi'i mchod tshig 'ga'/ /nyams ldan lta bu yi/ /don ldan bdud rtsi bzhugs// na mo gu ru de ba maṇ+ḍa lā ya/ gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /smon 'jug sems bskyed do/ /bdag gzhan stong pa'i ngang / /rang nyid rta mgrin dmar/ /dbyug tho sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /khro bo'i rgyan chas rdzogs/ /dpa' bo'i gar stabs kyis/ /pad+ma nyi mar bzhugs/ /oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya gri ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar gsum sogs/ gser skyems snod bcud kun/ /stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /rin chen snod bzang du/ /phun tshogs bcud kyis khengs/ /'khor 'das dges bskyed gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ skyabs gcig dpal ldan bla ma dang / /'chi med 'khon ston sa skya pa/ /gdung rabs ngor rdzong gong tshar dang / /g.yag rong go shāka 'bum la sogs/ /bstan 'dzin ji snyed byon kun mchod/ /gegs srungs 'dod kun stsal du gsol/ /yang phur bde kye gsang ba 'dus/ /bka' babs yi dam lha tshogs sogs/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog rnam gsum mchod/ /gur mgon ral gcig 'dod khams dbang / /tsa turmu kha yum bzhi mchod/ /gegs srung 'dod kun stsal du gsol/ /gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra dang / /bha ṭa sring mo tse'u dmar/ /rgyal po bse yi khrab can dang / /nor lha 'go ba'i lha kun mchod/ /gegs srung 'dod kun stsal du gsol/ ༈ /a ho 'khor 'das kun/ /bdag gi gser skyems kyis/ /mnyes nas phrin 'di gson/ /thub bstan yongs rdzogs bdag /sa skya'i bstan pa spel/ /gdung kun zhabs brtan mdzod/ /der brten skye 'gro yi/ /bsam don mthar phyin dang / /khyad par dbus kyi ljongs/ /sa'i cha rnam rab kyi/ /mthong smon grwa tshang gi /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor spel/ /de yi 'gal rkyen kun/ /srung pa'i mel tshe zhu/ /phar tshad 'dul mngon dang / /dbu sdom rig gzhung la/ /g.yag rong go rams rje'i/ /rnam thar zin nyid mdzod/

/dbang lung man ngag kun/ /'jam mgon sa skya pa'i/ /bka' srol bzang po'i rgyun/ /smin grol bdud rtsi yi/ /grub gnyis dga' ston gyis/ /snod ldan re skong shog /bkra shis phyogs kun nas/ /sprin phung ltar 'khrigs pas/ /grub gnyis zim char gyis/ /dge legs lo tog gi /g.yur za ldem ldem dang / /'bras bu phung phung shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ /dge 'dis 'gro kun la/ /gnas skabs bde skyid dang / /phyi ma'i don chen kun/ /myur shog bla ma mkhyen/ /ha 'di hi zhes su/ /hu ldan kun blo yis/ /he zhes dwags kun dga' rnam rgyal grwa blar/ /ho kun 'byung phyir bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ oṃ dang āḥhūm̐ gi bdud rtsi'i mchod tshig 'ga'/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
